definitions.body_denominator: All nonzero-offset tokens wholly contained in that visible message's article/body span; excludes headers, delimiters, Q JSON, D tool definitions, and mixed body/structure tokens, including unsampled pure body tokens.
definitions.first_last_25pct: First and last ceil(pure_body_token_count/4) token ranks, respectively; the two edge sets may overlap for messages shorter than four tokens.
definitions.absolute_input_quartile: q=1+min(3,floor(4*token_ix/complete_input_token_count)), including all unscored structural context in the denominator.
definitions.scores: Only existing supervised targets are scored; absent true roles have N/A recall/F1, while false positives are reported for all six outputs.

confidence_intervals.note: No per-cell bootstrap is added; retain the original final-test 2000 source-cluster overall bootstrap when available.
